method: Bounded read-only current source audit. No runtime, released-binary or deployed-backend verification. Official provider research is delegated separately; existing linked documents are not newly read by this audit.

completeExistingGuideReads.proof: Complete calendar-export-ics-pdf-and-backup and event-saved-to-wrong-calendar objects: all prose, steps, FAQs and sources read.
Complete three-calendar-apps-is-two-too-many object. Already distinguishes checked overview from merging accounts and preserving source apps.

nativeEvidence.proof: URL/userActivity handlers parse calendar invitation or resolve shared-event payload then present import sheets. Not generic document import.
URL parser accepts app-specific App Clip, service invitation or cloudcalendars handoff. Syncable requires eventID and feedID. This parser does not accept arbitrary .ics files or webcal URLs.

Add invokes SharedEventImporter with selected calendar; permissions and missing writable destination are distinct errors. Destination picker filters allowsContentModifications; preferred destination fallback is explicit.

Full calendar access required. Existing matching event is reused/tracked; otherwise choose existing writable calendar, create EKEvent and save thisEvent. Initial copied fields: title/start/end/all-day/location/timezone/URL. Syncable payload then triggers refresh for fuller data; not arbitrary file import, not whole-calendar migration.

Tracked shared event refresh reconciles sequence, cancellation title, time/location/URL, writable details and supplements; save may use futureEvents for recurrence. A recipient copy is not necessarily a detached backup, and refresh completion is not guaranteed.

Writable shared detail application sets notes/timezone/availability/alarms/recurrence/structured location. Does not assign organizer or attendees as native EventKit participant identities; no universal field fidelity claim.

Reachable Share toolbar guarded by canShare; event/local descriptor dispatch to EventAppClipSharing. fileImporter adds attachments, max5 and <=1MB each, not calendar records. Save destination requires editable calendar. AppLocal<->EventKit move saves target then deletes source; EventKit->local rolls back target on failed removal. Recurring EventKit save/removal uses futureEvents. Immediate detail Calendar change invokes persistSelectedDestination. No guaranteed migration of guests, exception instances or all metadata.
Share requires signed-in account and a generated shareable URL, then App Clip/email/QR delivery choices. No entire-calendar download UI established by these paths.

backendEvidence.proof: Backend can serialize feed VEVENTs (UID/sequence/dates/title/location/URL/notes/availability/geo/first recurrence/organizer/attendees/private metadata/alarms/status). BuildFeed publishes supplied events with one-hour refresh hints. This is feed serialization, not evidence of an app export button or guaranteed receiver fidelity; comments describing lossless sync are not treated as proof.

boundedSearch.scope: Native Calendar Swift source searched for export/Export/ICS/.ics/fileImporter/fileExporter/UIDocumentPicker; sharing and event editor call paths read as listed. Backend calendar/core/shared-event route names searched for feed/buildFeed/export. No runtime files or customer data accessed.
boundedSearch.result: No whole-calendar file-export UI, general ICS calendar-file importer, bulk provider-account transfer wizard or arbitrary feed-add UI established. Nonexistence beyond inspected scope is not claimed.

supportedSourceSteps: Share an eligible event through the app invitation paths after sign-in and successful URL generation.
Accept a recognized app invitation into an existing writable EventKit destination after permission; inspect the destination.
Move an eligible existing event through its Calendar selection; this is an action, not a preview or backup.
Use provider/Mac export instructions already distinguished in the website; this audit does not newly validate those external instructions.
unestablished: A Cloud Calendars whole-calendar ICS/CSV/PDF export or restore workflow.
A Cloud Calendars general .ics-file import or arbitrary webcal-subscription UI.
Automatic cross-provider bulk migration or migration-completion guarantee.
Preservation of all organizer/attendee identities, invitation responses, recurrence exceptions, conferencing, attachments and provider-specific fields in every transfer.
Identical behavior for every destination/provider or installed version.

copiedFieldsAndRestrictions.invitationInitial: Title, start/end, all-day, location, timezone, event URL; writable destination and full calendar permission.
copiedFieldsAndRestrictions.invitationRefresh: Additional writable details and supplemental metadata may be reconciled when a syncable invite successfully refreshes. Do not promise immediate arrival or native recreation of organizer/attendee identities.
copiedFieldsAndRestrictions.editorMove: Editor serializes visible fields, two alert choices, recurrence rule, structured location and supplemental attachments/travel/video URL; local/eventkit representations differ. Existing EventKit object may retain other fields, but all-field portability is not established.
copiedFieldsAndRestrictions.recurrence: EventKit save/remove uses futureEvents for recurring records in these paths; no user-visible occurrence-scope prompt established by this audit.
copiedFieldsAndRestrictions.filePicker: Attachment ingestion is distinct from ICS event import even when allowedContentTypes is generic data.

bestExistingCanonicalImprovement.placement: Treat an existing destination change as an action
bestExistingCanonicalImprovement.proposedParagraph: Moving an event between an app-local calendar and a calendar in the iPhone calendar system is not a backup operation. Cloud Calendars saves it in the chosen destination and then removes the original backing record. For a repeating event, do not assume this moves only the date you opened. If you need a separate archival copy or a precise one-date exception, use an appropriate supported export or provider workflow first.
bestExistingCanonicalImprovement.why: Current guide already warns about immediate save and provider recurrence differences, but does not explicitly explain cross-store source removal. This fills a concrete decision gap without another migration route.
bestExistingCanonicalImprovement.boundary: Do not turn internal rollback into a public guarantee that every failure preserves every record; do not recommend moving real events as a transfer experiment.

secondaryTargetedAddition.proposedParagraph: Accepting a Cloud Calendars event invitation is a different operation from importing a downloaded calendar file. Review the writable destination before adding the event. An invitation that follows the sender’s updates should not be treated as an independent backup, and adding a document as an event attachment does not import its calendar records.
secondaryTargetedAddition.dedup: Current eight-section guide already covers provider export, PDF, CSV, subscription refresh, privacy and representative verification. No standalone generic migration guide is justified from native evidence alone.

limits: Website source hashes reflect current working tree at inspection.
Source inspection does not establish production behavior, UI availability on a particular device or a completed migration.
No new external provider claim verified here; combine with keyword agent official-source research before publication.
